svg.title: Preparing a GPU machine for GPU Deck
svg.desc: Preparing a GPU machine in four steps. 1, driver: install the vendor driver and check that it lists every GPU (nvidia-smi, amd-smi). 2, container runtime, optional and only for the vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM images: Docker or Podman plus the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. 3, network: outbound only, 8443 and 8444-8445 to the control plane and 443 to model hubs; direct mode adds inbound 9443 from the API layer. 4, join: run the install command from Nodes, Add node; it pins the control plane's CA and starts the agent as a service. Then the agent does the rest: pinned engine builds, the model cache, the host firewall, certificates and their rotation, metrics and logs. Only when needed: MIG profiles before joining, the MPS daemon for compute-share slices, Python 3.12 for SGLang Diffusion, the CUDA toolkit for native SGLang.
